events.question: note
events.text: SEARCH — one pipeline, two shells: the ⌘K overlay and search.html are thin shells over scripts/search-core.js, which owns all knowledge and behaviour

events.question: note
events.text: Tier 0 — BM25 (MiniSearch) + a regex intent grammar: instant, always on

events.question: note
events.text: Tier 0.5 — semantic: a MiniLM q8 embedder on WASM over precomputed chunk vectors; results upgrade in place by reciprocal-rank fusion

events.question: note
events.text: Tier 1 — in-browser LFM2.5-350M (q4f16) on WebGPU via Transformers.js; 0.2s to first token — never in Safari, where onnxruntime WebGPU never initialises

events.question: note
events.text: Tier 2 — local LMStudio/Ollama: never probed on load, localhost only after the visitor opts in

events.question: note
events.text: Assets/search-chunks.json — flat factual chunks with urls, anchors and int8 vecs; rebuilt by build-chunk-vectors.mjs. Feeds Tier 0 and Tier 0.5

events.question: note
events.text: Out: answers as one adaptive-density postcard — plus command cards from JH_COMMANDS; tool-use renders as a confirm chip, never auto-run

events.question: note
events.text: CANVAS — the hand draws: index hero (fish minigame), design.html blueprint maze, 404 ambient fish, playground review canvas

events.question: note
events.text: ShapeDetect — a stroke reads as circle, square, triangle, arrow, line; morph + whisper label

events.question: note
events.text: Walls are drawn outlines (block chains): a rectangle is a pen, a circle a ring tank. Erase is relational — a stroke crossing an outline 3+ times removes it

events.question: note
events.text: scripts/fish-engine.js — one engine everywhere: layered behaviour stack (edge → heading → state → collision → formation → wander), rooms flood-filled from open water, and a nav field (BFS from every food pellet) so fish route around walls

events.question: note
events.text: The living canvas: fish swim the maze you drew — you draw, it swims, you draw again

events.question: note
events.text: the seam: search commands act on the canvases — feed, spawn, clear, labels — the bar as the sites interface

steps.caption: The search column: two shells over one core, four tiers
The canvas column: the hand draws, the engine reads, the fish swim it
The flows: tiers cascade, chunks feed the bottom two, commands cross to the canvases, the canvas feeds back
What each part is, said in its own words — the whole system on one board
